nha_standard_sheets.check: Every printed dimension equals the implemented values: flange widths are dimensioned as projection+web+projection (e.g. A 185+180+185; H 455+190+455 top, 280+190+280 bottom); D1-D5 chains close to H; bottom splays 1:1 (projection = D4) and top splays about 1:2 (projection/D2 = 2.0-2.06), consistent with the drawn 1:1 and 2:1 slope marks.

geometry_notes: All values are transcribed from Table 1 of the 2025 paper, PDF p2, checked visually and against its text layer. D1+D2+D3+D4+D5 = H closes exactly for all eight types.
The paper's first span cell reads '20-Dec', a spreadsheet date conversion error; the NHA index text gives 12-20 m. It is recorded here as 12-20.

CONVENTION: Table 1 is read as a five-segment I (top flange side D1, straight top splay D2, clear web D3, straight bottom splay D4, bottom flange side D5), with all splays straight and no chamfers or fillets. The table has no other parameters.

RESOLVED 2026-09-25: the paper's Figure 1 AASHTO-like schematic (p3) is not the NHA section. The NHA summary page's own schematic shows the five-segment I with straight top and bottom splays (D1 flange edge, D2 splay, D3 web, D4 splay, D5 flange edge) used here. the paper's Figure 1 schematic (p3) labels a different, AASHTO-like outline with a two-slope top flange underside (D2, D3, D4 and a break width B4) and a bottom D5/D6 chain. Its labels do not match Table 1, which has no B4 or D6. The Figure 1 outline is not used here. The NHA STANDARD/04-06 sheets must govern once they are retrieved.
No section-property table is published. Gross properties are analytic only.
These are Pakistani NHA types. They are not the US AASHTO Types I-VI, and no US geometry is transferred.
Midspan gross concrete only. End blocks, ducts and reinforcement are excluded.
2026-09-25: geometry confirmed directly against NHA drawings STANDARD/04-06; these govern. The journal table and summary page are corroborating reproductions.
